Ultraman Teo Actress Noa Nekada Dies at 23
 posted on 2026-11-16 16:00 EST by Alex Mateo
 Ongoing Ultraman Teo series will broadcast as planned with Nekada's already-filmed scenes 
 Image via Ultraman series' X/Twitter account © 円⾕プロ ©ウルトラマンテオ製作委員会・テレビ東京 TOHO Entertainment revealed on Monday that actress Noa Nekada has died. She was 23. There was a funeral for close family.
 Nekada was born on June 21, 2003 in Ishikawa Prefecture.
 Nekada played Kanna Izumi in the ongoing live-action Ultraman Teo tokusatsu series. TV Tokyo confirmed on Monday that it has filmed the entire series already, including Nekada's appearances, and the series will broadcast as planned. 
 Sources: Toho Entertainment , TV Tokyo
